{{Quote|We must not show weakness!|The Nikto senator|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
A '''[[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]''' was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] was debating whether or not to deregulate [[Bank/Legends|the banks]] and open loans to purchase additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for [[Clone Wars/Legends|the war]] which could possibly leave the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in deeper debt that it already was. After a recent attack on the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] contacted the Senate and angrily informed them of a Republic attack that took the lives of many. As a result, he pulled back the peace proposal which [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had recently erected with the help of her Separatist friend, [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]], who according to Dooku, had been among the victims of the Republic attack. After Dooku ended contact, the Nikto senator shouted that the Republic must remain strong and not show any weakness which was backed up by numerous [[Unidentified Aqualish senator|other senators]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />
